name: AWK
note: Named after its creators, Aho, Weinberger, and Kernighan
typeSystem: Dynamic; an expression can have a string value, a numeric value, or both. AWK converts implicitly according to context, a model well suited to splitting and reformatting lines of text.
runtime: An AWK program is a set of pattern-action rules; the interpreter reads its input one record (typically a line) at a time, splits it into fields, and runs any rule whose pattern matches.

runtimes.name: awk / gawk / mawk
runtimes.role: Reads input line by line, automatically splitting each line into fields, and executes matching pattern-action rules.

concurrencyModel: N/A; a single AWK process reads and processes its input sequentially, one record at a time.
